adjudicators.kind: distinct registered natural persons; no model- or third-party-generated codes
adjudicators.independence: same inputs (E1 snapshot material, E2 starting links, this protocol); separate reading; neither sees the other's evidence or codes until both records for the block are sealed by hash
adjudicators.disagreement: UNRESOLVED; no tie-break, no third reviewer, no second pass

evidence_hierarchy.E1: the primary entry's definition file at the pinned commit (cite commit + path). Leads and hints only
evidence_hierarchy.E2: the ONLY starting URLs: a1_evidence.e2_leads(primary entry) — info.x-origin[].url, externalDocs.url, info.termsOfService, info.contact.url, servers[].url (variables filled only from their own defaults), Swagger-2.0 scheme+host+basePath; absolute http(s) with a DNS host only; relative, unresolved-template, IP-literal, non-DNS and malformed values are dropped and recorded
evidence_hierarchy.E3: first-party documentation that is explicitly licensed for copying: read under E4 rules; the licence may allow a retained copy but never adds pages, time or sources
evidence_hierarchy.E4: ordinary logged-out human browser reading of public first-party pages reached from E2 leads via visible links
evidence_hierarchy.E6_excluded: search engines, guessed or constructed URLs, reviews, forums, rankings, model memory, third-party mirrors, the quarantined drafts, prior FIRSTCALL outcomes
evidence_hierarchy.no_substitution: adjudicators may not examine, adopt or switch to any other entry, key, product or service in the RDG because the primary entry is difficult, inaccessible or ineligible; normal EXCLUDED/UNRESOLVED rules apply to the primary entry's surface

navigation.rule: follow only visible first-party links whose URL path contains a vocabulary term; external hosts are first-party only if an E2 lead or first-party page links them as official

terms_stage.pages: counted separately from the eligibility budget

navigation.retry: a page that fails to load may be retried once after >= 30 minutes within the same key's slot; failed pages consume their slot
prohibited: automated scraping, crawling or bulk download
navigation.browser: registered pinned browser version, clean profile, never logged in, strictly-necessary cookies only, UK network egress
navigation.translation: non-English pages only through the registered translation tool (role R09); uncertain translation => UNRESOLVED
navigation.spec_parser: the primary entry is parsed only by the registered pinned parser (role R17)

predicates.I0: the platform/journey surface documented by the primary entry is identifiable from E1/E2/E4 evidence (which service and control plane the entry's API belongs to)
predicates.I1: has public documentation — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.I2: advertises a test/sandbox mode OR a free self-serve tier supporting a reversible effect — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.I3: self-serve signup without an enterprise sales contract (UK-resident individual developer) — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.I4: supports at least one journey object meeting the Freeze-1 effect requirements per public documentation — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.E1: enterprise-contract-only — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.E2: no safe test/sandbox capability per public documentation — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.E3: requires real money/PII/irreversible effect with no sandbox — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.E4: region-locked or KYC-gated beyond a sandbox for a UK-resident individual developer — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.E6: FIRSTCALL-authored/operated or prior designated target (approved prior-FIRSTCALL registry) — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.T1: applicable first-party terms explicitly prohibit automated agents of the kind the journey requires — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.T2: applicable first-party terms explicitly prohibit benchmarking/testing of the kind the journey requires — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.T3: applicable first-party terms explicitly prohibit publication of the derived result/evidence FIRSTCALL publishes — for the platform/journey surface of the primary entry
predicates.C01-C07: Freeze-1.1 functional category membership; descriptive only, but >= 1 agreed TRUE is required for scope

coding.TRUE_FALSE: only with a recorded factual proposition and evidence record; silence never supports FALSE for an inclusion or TRUE for an exclusion
coding.terms_FALSE_meaning: for T1-T3, FALSE means 'applicable first-party terms were located and read within budget and no explicit prohibition was observed'. Reported neutrally as NO_EXPLICIT_RESTRICTION_OBSERVED, never as permission
UNRESOLVED_whenever: evidence inaccessible after the frozen retry
terms requiring login or acceptance not available for prospective review
coding.monotonicity: once affirmative authoritative evidence for a fatal predicate has been recorded, later contrary evidence makes that predicate UNRESOLVED (contradiction), never the opposite affirmative code
coding.login_wall_rule: if every E2 documentation lead of the primary entry is login-walled, I1 = FALSE (affirmative observation); if only evidence for a particular predicate is login-walled, that predicate = UNRESOLVED

fatal_exclusion_stop.rule: an adjudicator who affirmatively establishes a fatal predicate seals their record with fatal_stop = that predicate and stops reading that key. When both records are sealed: same fatal predicate affirmed by both => EXCLUDED (terminal, further budget not spent); otherwise the normal combination applies (a unilateral stop cannot yield RESOLVED_ELIGIBLE)
record: pages and minutes consumed at termination

retention.access_controls: technical access controls and explicit access restrictions are respected; nothing is circumvented
retention.publication_gate: any commercial or non-research publication of records requires a separate legal-review gate; this protocol is not legal advice

timing.rule: the entropy custodian releases block b only after block b-1 is sealed; both adjudicators read every key of block b within 48 h of release and seal their records; statuses are combined mechanically only after both seals
timing.release_cadence: at most 3 blocks per calendar week
timing.planning_basis: expected RDGs screened for n=24 over |G| (unknown before retrieval; at most ~701): n(|G|+1)/(M_G+1) — e.g. with |G|=701: 237 at 10% S-prevalence, 159 at 15%, 120 at 20%, 80 at 30%
timing.bound_exceeded: recorded deviation; screening continues to the stop rule or exhaustion. Time never truncates the sample (a time cut-off could depend on unit difficulty)
timing.no_readjudication: sealed records and statuses are final; later changes go to a post-sample change log

diagnostics.position_drift: Cochran-Armitage trend test of the S indicator and of the UNRESOLVED indicator against block index, two-sided alpha 0.05, reported with per-block rates; diagnostic only, never alters the sample
diagnostics.adjudicator_rates: per-adjudicator UNRESOLVED, fatal-stop and disagreement rates by block

unit: one RDG, examined ONLY through its primary entry as fixed in the sealed frame

relationships.observed_relationships: an adjudicator may record a cross-domain relationship (e.g. 'this surface shares a control plane with <other RDG id>') only when independently established by the ordinary frozen evidence process
relationships.effect: descriptive only; never alters inclusion, weighting, denominator, primary estimate, replacement or eligibility; never used for merging, de-duplication or any vendor-level estimator
